newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau to expand air cargo facilites by February 97.
newsitem.headline: Macau to expand air cargo facilites by February 97.

text.p: Air cargo handling facilities at Macau International Airport (MIA) are to be improved with completion expected by February 1997, an airport company spokesman said.
Construction work is to begin on three additional stands for cargo aircraft adjacent to the cargo terminal which should mean faster handling, the spokesman said.

"At the moment cargo aircraft have to be unloaded at the other end of the airport from the cargo terminal and it takes longer for it to be trucked over. This new hard stand parking area is right in front of the terminal so it should make handling much more efficient," the MIA spokesman added.

The south apron extension is being carried out by the airport's cargo terminal operator, MASC Ogden Aviation Services, providing stands for one Boeing 747 and two McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighters,the airport said.
MIA says it now has four scheduled cargo operators, Scandinavian Airline System, EVA Air, Asiana Airlines and Gemini Air Cargo. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44-171-542-7706 Fax +44-171-542-5017
